headline: Execution picks up; Order inflow still the missing link

highlights: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating HOLD HOLD Target Price 114 136 Sales (INR mn) 100,326 113,782 100,326 117,337 % Chng. - (3.0) EBITDA (INR mn) 5,048 5,699 4,573 5,412 % Chng. 10.4 5.3 EPS (INR) 7.3 7.9 7.7 8.5 % Chng.
EBITDA rose 61% YoY to INR 1.0bn, with margin at 4.9% vs 3.4% YoY.

However, PAT fell 34% YoY to INR 1.22bn (41% below our estimate), dragged by a 45% fall in other income to INR 976mn and a one-off tax of INR 127mn on the completed Sri Lanka project (tax rate 32.7% vs 18.4% YoY).

Order book stood at INR 213bn as on 1HFY27 (~2.4x TTM standalone revenue) vs INR 234bn in Q1FY27 and INR 250bn at FY26-end, implying inflows lagged execution during the quarter (implied H1 inflow of only ~INR 2bn); mix at ~76% railways, 91% domestic orders, 55% competitively bid.
valuation: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating HOLD HOLD Target Price 114 136 Sales (INR mn) 100,326 113,782 100,326 117,337 % Chng. - (3.0) EBITDA (INR mn) 5,048 5,699 4,573 5,412 % Chng. 10.4 5.3 EPS (INR) 7.3 7.9 7.7 8.5 % Chng.
Management now guides FY27E standalone revenue at INR 90-95bn (vs “broadly stable” earlier) and targets order inflows of INR 90-100bn; only ~INR 10bn has been secured so far.
We retain HOLD rating with revised TP of INR 114 (earlier INR 136) as we lower EPS for FY28E/29E by 5%/7% factoring lower execution and value EPC at lower multiple of 20x 1HFY29.
